## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -0.47%) and TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.89% | 1M: -5.06%) confirm mixed/downside pressure alongside narrow sector participation.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Narrow breadth (3/11) is the dominant limiter on conviction. Credit stress creeping: HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -2.39%) and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -3.59%) ↓ falling, while VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -3.54%) ↓ falling shows muted fear.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Rates tightening signal via TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.89% | 1M: -5.06%) ↓ falling (higher yields); overall financial conditions read neutral given mixed asset moves and flat macro ratios.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Commodity/energy beta leading: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%) ↑ rising and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +3.45%) ↑ rising. Tech showing short-term weakness: XLK CORRECTION (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +3.26%) and broad cyclicals/financials under pressure per sector breadth.

5. US vs Global?  
US equities mixed: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -0.47%) while QQQ CORRECTION (1W: -0.67% | 1M: +2.24%). EM/China remain weak: EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -0.61%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.12% | 1M: -3.04%).

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Cooling speculative appetite: IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -3.67% | 1M: +4.24%), ETHA CORRECTION (1W: -3.36% | 1M: +6.78%) and ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +2.14%). Small caps are weak: IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.95% | 1M: -6.36%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Oil/energy strength is the clearest macro theme: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +15.38%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%). Metals/gold are under pressure: GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -10.58%) and SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -12.46%).

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy mixed-to-strong: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +0.29%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%) and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +3.45%) point to commodity-specific strength despite sector-level volatility.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: Commodity/energy ETFs (BNO, USO, UNG) ABOVE TREND; confirmed weakness: SPY and TLT BELOW TREND. MAJOR divergence present — multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches across XLK, QQQ, IBIT, ARKK — which suppresses strong regime conviction.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor commodity/energy exposure and monitor credit sensitivity: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%) and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +3.45%) showing strength; reduce exposure to duration (TLT BELOW TREND) and small caps (IWM BELOW TREND) while watching tech (XLK CORRECTION) for further deterioration.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Energy/Commodities — BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +15.38%), UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +3.45%).  
BEARISH: Precious metals and defensive sectors — GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -10.58%), SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -12.46%), XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -8.43%).

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +15.38%).  
BEARISH: Gold/Precious metals — GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -10.58%), PALL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.46%).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD 0.80 (credit health pivot); XLK/XLF relative ratio ~2.0 (style pivot) — monitor these for regime clarity.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, producing low conviction despite pockets of commodity strength. BNO and UNG showing relative strength while tech and credit divergences (XLK CORRECTION; HYG/LQD BELOW TREND) are the key risks to monitor.
